title: Tactical breakdown
brief: A tactician's-chalkboard read of Morocco 1-1 Netherlands (Morocco won 3-2 on penalties), the FIFA World Cup 2026 Round of 32 tie in Monterrey on 29 June 2026. Interactive SVG pitch diagrams toggle between four phases — Morocco's build-up, its pressing triggers, the Dutch transition that produced Gakpo's 72nd-minute goal, and the Morocco corner that Issa Diop headed in at 90+1 — with hand-drawn marker arrows, yellow release lanes, pressing rings and Hakimi's heatmap zone. Real formations (Morocco 4-3-3, Koeman's 3-4-2-1) and confirmed XIs; the decisive Hakimi-vs-Van de Ven duel; verified stats from football-data (event 760488: possession 70.1/29.9, shots on target 5/2, 879/371 passes); the full 3-2 shootout ladder; and Maradona's plain-language read of why the plan worked, where it breaks, and the one adjustment he'd make. Every result and stat cited.
da: Tactician's chalkboard — deep slate-green board, chalk-white pitch lines and marker-drawn arrows, Rock Salt/Caveat chalk display over Archivo Narrow + Inter analysis, chalk-dust grain.
